checks.name: six sound sets with every auditioned variant: clink 4, pile 4, spill 4, cascade 3, gold 2, gold over the edge 1

checks: every note of every variant has finite times and volumes

checks.name: each coin sound is the audition's note list at its auditioned level (every note's time, pitch, length, volume and envelope)

rendered, each coin sound is as loud as its audition WAV (loudest 100 ms above 250 Hz, average of 6 plays, within 1.5 dB: the notes are identical, but each play draws new noise, so a 10 ms click varies a little from the one recording Jenny heard)
the pusher whoosh is noise only: no tones, no drum or click (every note fades in over 60 ms or more)
the whoosh plays at the auditioned level at Pusher sound 50% (within 0.5 dB of pusher-w5-warm-whoosh.wav, above 250 Hz)
sets: no errors with sound on
in a round: coins dropped on the board play the current landing and the new drops on pile; coins knocking play the current clink and the new clinks
the pusher: one whoosh per stroke (forward and back), faster in Turbo (0.675 s strokes instead of 1.44 s)
the recorded pusher sound (pusher.mp3) never plays
round: no errors with sound on, nothing dropped from the sound queue
one coin over the edge keeps its current sound (the original edge code, coin-off)
three coins over the edge within 0.35 s play the current edge sound or a new spill
ten or more within 1 s play the current edge sound or a new big cascade (right after the spill the first three started)

checks: prizes and other pieces over the edge keep the old edge sounds

checks.name: fix A: a gold coin's first landing plays the gold clink or the current clink (no drop-on-pile, no gold drop), a rain coin's a clink (no drop-on-pile); gold paid at the front: the shimmer every other time
rotation: each pick is the current sound or a new variant, all of them come up about equally, never the same twice in a row
edge: no errors with sound on

untouched: the current coin landing, clink and edge sounds, the pickup (ledge bell, landing thump, the Pop), the music, ka-ching, the mouth drop, the stack tumble and the pusher timing are the same code as the base build
sound off: no audio nodes and no errors in a round
